d: Solar System stations, moons, and Ring Gate worlds from James S. A. Corey’s The Expanse.

ceres.x: Spun-up dwarf planet serving as the largest trading hub and demographic capital of the Outer Planets Alliance (OPA) in the Asteroid Belt.

433-eros.x: Near-Earth asteroid station infected with the Phoebe Protomolecule during the Eros Incident in Leviathan Wakes.

ganymede.x: Orbital-mirror agricultural dome complex on Jupiter’s largest moon supplying food and obstetric care across the Jovian system.

io.x: Volcanic Jovian moon hosting the clandestine Protomolecule hybrid research facility in Caliban’s War.

titan.x: Major Saturnian domed colony and high-gravity naval resort in the outer Solar System.

phoebe.x: Retrograde irregular moon of Saturn captured from interstellar space, where Protogen discovered the extrasolar Protomolecule.

canon-the-expanse:ilus.x: Lithium-rich extrasolar world beyond the Ring Gates settled by Belter refugees and Royal Charter Energy in Cibola Burn.

b.s: Hard science-fiction series chronicling humanity’s colonisation of the Solar System (Earth, Mars, the Asteroid Belt, and outer-planet moons) and the discovery of the Extrasolar Protomolecule Ring network.
b.a: James S. A. Corey (Daniel Abraham & Ty Franck)
